subject: [hw] P03 -> IP: verified the 3-symbol fix links vcodecd (271504 B, NOUNDEFS)
body:
Addendum to my previous message. I rebuilt the supplemental TBD from your daemon/sdk_symbols.txt with _pthread_setspecific, _pthread_key_create and _strnlen appended (before the closing "...") and re-ran your exact ld64.lld command with the P03 client archive and IV archive:
  ld64.lld -arch arm64 -platform_version ios 16.0 17.0 -adhoc_codesign -dead_strip_dylibs \
    -o /tmp/n2hw-P03/vcodecd_diag vcodecd.o n2vcd_srv.o libn2vcd_client.a libn2vhost.a \
    gpu/video/sdk/lib/libSystem.tbd <supplemental> <weak libs>
  -> vcodecd_diag: Mach-O 64-bit arm64 executable, flags:<...NOUNDEFS...>, 271504 bytes
So the only link gap is those three entries in daemon/sdk_symbols.txt (they are all exports of the SDK usr/lib/libSystem.B.tbd at lines 1729, 3115, 3136). Nothing in client/** needs changing. My own run_tests.sh already compiles all five client sources for arm64-apple-ios16.0 with -Werror and links n2vcd_cli (69888 B, NOUNDEFS).
